developments.reason: Request: at round 10 Wren (health 100, satiety 85, energy 38.1, on forest floor at 10.71, 12.24, owning item-4-wren-39, five meadow roots harvested at tick 4 with decay 7.8983692) asked for a practical, personally learnable method that slows spoilage of harvested roots through real preparation or storage work, with stated limits and a way to compare treated and untreated roots. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) one general operation, prepare ventilated food storage, with a food stack, quantity, support materials, location and mode (prepare, load, inspect, maintain, unload or compare): a small open raised lattice of two supports and three crosspieces with a declared size and load rating that holds separated intact roots off wet soil; material and site inspection 1 round and 1 energy, assembly 3 rounds at 1 energy, loading or unloading 0.5 energy per root, inspection or comparison 0.5, maintenance 1; the pieces become one object, loading partitions the stack without resetting decay, an intact, clean, not overloaded rack multiplies the positive decay increment of compatible intact roots by the declared coefficient 0.8 only while measured conditions permit passive drying (no rain or standing water, adequate ventilation, food not wetter or warmer than the tracked ordinary-storage control), otherwise 1, with a paired comparison after at least 5 rounds and the stated pause, resume, cancel, maintenance and death rules. What the world represents: the authoritative decay update is forest-environment.ts, which for every stack runs the food water exchange (preservationExchange) and then adds rootAge(preservationAge(max(0.15, (T + 4) / 24) x enclosure factor)) at the temperature where the food ages; under the installed food water representation (state.foodWater) whole unprepared food never evaporates, rain on an exposed surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water without runoff, carried food exchanges nothing, and roots are assumed to be 0.75 water; rain in this seed falls from about round 11 to 128 and is absent from 128 to 244; a branch unit is 1.1 kg with flexibility 2; roots are 0.4 kg with lifetime 240. Decay hook and gate: that sum now passes its increment through ventilatedRackDecay in a new physics module, which returns it unchanged unless prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1 is installed and the stack is the stored lot that a rack's hidden record names (the same object as the world stack); only then are the coded checks evaluated and 0.8 applied to a positive increment; a world without the revision is unchanged, which the test shows on a copy with a recorded lot whose step is byte-identical to the same world without the record. Equivalence and reuse: no installed ability prepares or stores food; ex16 branch-screen@1 gave the staged paid assembly of whole branch units into one real object, installed-piece records, pause, resume, cancel, death, wear and release of removed pieces, but its drawing is a vertical woven line labelled as a screen and cannot render a rack; ex21 small-combustion-source@1 gave smallFireRod (900 kg/m3, 25 diameters: a 0.0396 x 0.991 m rod per branch unit) and its rigidity limit 3; ex19 lever-mass-comparator@1 gave the material-geometry@1 wood modulus 4e9 Pa and strength 45e6 Pa and the visible bending limit of 0.02 of the half-beam; ex19 food-air-exposure-trial@1 gave the whole untreated food check (airExposureUnsupported) and the carried control, ex21 air-dry-food-trial@1 the food-on-a-support pattern and the 0.04 per-unit footprint, and food-water.ts foodWaterExpose, foodWaterInitialize, foodWaterRead, foodWaterSurfaceArea and foodWaterWithdraw; ex19 contact and firm-ground checks, the ex11/ex15 lean-to wear law and the 0.5 sound condition were reused; no existing package was changed, and the test asserts one digest over all 118 previously registered packages and the individual hashes of foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, simple-shelter@1, branch-screen@1, food-air-exposure-trial@1, lever-mass-comparator@1, air-dry-food-trial@1, small-combustion-source@1 and propagate-from-seed@1. Implemented (full mechanism, not a first release): prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1 (ability and handler long.prepare-ventilated-food-storage, equivalence food:raised-branch-rack-storage:1, learning 3, 3,377 code units, registered last, visual component ventilated-food-rack, no satisfaction source) with modes prepare, load, unload, inspect, compare, maintain, dismantle and cancel. prepare (x, y in reach, orientation, exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units of branch, willow, birch or oak, the first two as supports, optional food and quantity as the proposed load) pays a 1-energy inspection round that handles every piece for treatment or residue records, contamination or fracture, rigidity, soundness and length, checks the site for water, wet bank, waterlogging, hazards, overlapping plants or objects, people, enclosure and a 0.25 m ventilation margin, and compares the proposed load with the capacity and the rating; a shortfall is reported with each finding and nothing is reserved or touched; otherwise the five units are reserved with a progress record (site, recipe, capacity, paid energy) and a planned rack object, and three paid rounds lay the supports, two crosspieces, then the last one and run the stability and load check, after which the 0.8 x 0.2 m deck, 0.079 m above the soil, is a food surface of the representation with capacity 4 and rating 74.06 kg (37.03 kg per crosspiece) and the five units exist only inside the rack. load (rack, own food, quantity at most 4, controlQuantity) splits the stack exactly into a lot laid unowned on the deck with foodWaterExpose and an optional control kept carried and reserved, both with the source's quantity tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and starts a paired record; each round the decay update checks rack completeness and soundness, the lot lying on the deck, compatible intact roots, capacity and rating, no other material on the deck, no rain on the lot, no standing water under the deck, outdoors with wind and no solid object in the margin, and the lot not wetter or warmer than its control; after the decay update the record accumulates paired increments, rain, wet and favourable rounds and temperature differences, rain water on the deck is dried at the representation's own evaporation limit, and wear, damage, collapse, removal, spoilage and loss of the control are handled. unload returns the lot to the builder and releases the control; inspect reports the observable state for 0.5 energy; compare, after at least 5 paired rounds, reports decay gained by lot and control, per round and as a share of lifetime, their ratio and difference, the disclosed exposure and the allowance that unequal temperatures alone explain, and shows slower decay only when the difference exceeds that allowance, otherwise no demonstrated benefit; maintain (empty deck) replaces named pieces after the same piece inspection and reruns the check without restoring food freshness; dismantle returns the pieces as worn ground stacks; cancel returns unlaid reserved units once; an unworked round pauses for free and resume (prepare naming the rack) rechecks reach, site, occupancy, reserved pieces and energy; death stops the work, drops unlaid units where the person died and leaves the incomplete rack. Events food-rack-materials-inspected, -started, -progress, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled, -failed, -completed, -check-failed, -loaded, -unloaded, -inspected, -compared, -conditions, -wetted, -dried, -food-removed, -food-spoiled, -control-lost, -deteriorated, -damaged, -collapsed, -maintained and -dismantled name the exact rack, items and quantities, and the rack object keeps reusable view metadata (status, footprint, deck height, work fraction, pieces with condition, capacity, rating, occupied units, wetness, rain, standing water, ventilation, favourable, conditional rate, comparison result) that the work, loading and comparison events also carry; the new viewer drawing shows a dashed footprint until the rack is complete, only laid pieces, grey loose pieces, blue-edged wet food, an airflow mark only while the coded checks pass and a slower-decay label only after a supporting comparison, with a viewer test; the existing drawings are unchanged. Owner rules: only the builder may prepare, resume, cancel, load, unload, compare, maintain or dismantle a rack; anyone in reach may inspect it; stored food lies unowned like any ground stack, so anyone may pick it up, which reduces or ends the stored lot; the control cannot be eaten or given until the lot ends; at death the lot stays on the rack and the control becomes an ordinary stack where the person died, still tracked. No reward: the review's proposed experience increments were not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards; no event carries a qualified flag and every personal record is unverified. Assumptions: (1) supports lie as rails 0.8 m apart on firm ground and crosspieces 0.08 m apart rest across them, so a 0.2 m root bears on at least two, with no cutting, lashing or cord; (2) the piece size is ex21's rod rather than branch-screen's declared 1.1 m woven rod, whose 0.015 m thickness does not match the unit mass; (3) the rating is a central point load over the span, the lower of bending strength / 2 and a bend of 0.02 of the half-span, and the deck rating is twice the weakest crosspiece because a load bears on at least two; supports bear on firm ground along their length and are not rated in bending; (4) capacity is one separated layer at 0.04 per unit, and a larger load needs another rack (no larger recipe in version 1); (5) rigidity is material flexibility at most 3, cleanliness is no treatment or residue record, contamination and fracture follow the ex19 contact model, and pieces are handled, so inspection needs no daylight; (6) adequate ventilation means outdoors, wind above 0 and no solid object within 0.25 m of the deck; people beside it do not count; (7) rain uptake is the representation's, so the deck area counts and long rain leaves the lot wetter than its control; rain-added water on the open deck evaporates at 0.025 x deck area x the representation's temperature factor but never below the loading composition, the only new water rule; (8) the ordinary-storage comparison is the tracked carried control while it exists; without one, or once it has spoiled, it is the lot's own loading water content and the air at the rack, so the rate never depends on keeping a control alive, while a control carried to cooler ground stops it as the check requires; (9) only whole intact meadow roots take the coefficient; other foods with a represented composition, such as berries, can be held but keep the ordinary rate, and food with any other treatment, preparation or enclosure is excluded, so modifiers never stack; (10) wear is 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) per round; a loose crosspiece makes the rack damaged with the food kept on the deck at the ordinary rate, a loose support collapses it and the food falls to the soil; (11) pausing keeps unlaid units carried and reserved, which is how they stay safe, cancel returns them once, dismantling costs a declared 1 round and 1 energy, and maintenance needs an empty deck; (12) the control is set aside in the loading round without extra energy. Wren can now study for 3 rounds, gather 5 branch units at start-0-branches 3.8 m away (10 energy and walking), inspect and build the rack beside her roots for 4 rounds and 4 energy, load 2 roots with 2 carried controls for 1 energy and compare after 5 paired rounds for 0.5.
